label: Burgemeester Hogguerstraat galerijflats (Noordoever Sloterplas, 1965, three identical 110 x 12.4 m slabs, 15 storeys): east access galleries with white concrete parapets over a row of 25 red garage doors between brown brick piers, a dark-framed glazed first floor on both long sides, west balconies with grey bar railings and white cross-wall fins over open ground-floor columns, buff brick gables, a buff brick lift tower with a glazed stair beside it at the north end and an open stair the galleries swing out to at the south end

notes: Identity: BAG (api.data.amsterdam.nl/v1/bag/panden/<id>): all three panden oorspronkelijk bouwjaar 1965, 'Meerdere woningen', buurt Noordoever Sloterplas; each holds 215 verblijfsobjecten, 190 woonfunctie (21 on floor 1, 13 on each of floors 2-14) and 25 'overige gebruiksfunctie' (the garages). Addresses Burgemeester Hogguerstraat 1-397 (0363100012095578), 399-793 (0363100012063809), 795-1223 (0363100012151987).

Front is the east gallery side (pinned frontBearingDeg 90 in variants.json); +x runs north. Annex u values are metres on the 109.5 m rectangle edge from the south (front) or north (back) end, measured on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 roof surfaces in the slab frame.

The footprint rectangle is the tall body from the 3DBAG roof (bodyFromRoof): the BAG rings hold the garage row and entrance halls too (ring-rectangle IoU 0.73-0.75). 0363100012196327 (the 3.9 m north end bay of 0363100012095578) and 0363100012201815 (the west entrance extension and a slice of 0363100012063809) are absorbed by their slabs and suppressed with them.

Not modelled: the gallery slabs bend out diagonally to the south stair (here a square step), small stair/landings from the first floor onto the garage roof, planters on the garage roof, per-flat awnings, the curved gallery ends, slab overrun past the gables, the 48.5 m lift motor box.
